subject: Project initiation: book kickoff call, attendee roster, and run of show
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@healthsync.com>
Cc: Nikhil Rao <nra@healthsync.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Project initiation: book kickoff call, attendee roster, and run of show

Hi Claire —

Great to meet you (virtually) last week. We’re excited to get HealthSync into the onboarding queue. To keep momentum, can we lock a 60-minute kickoff next week to cover goals, integration touchpoints, and roles?

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 31 Aug, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 1 Sep, 14:00–15:00
- Thu 2 Sep, 09:00–10:00

Agenda draft (attached): 1) introductions & success goals, 2) system access & SSO, 3) data flows & retention, 4) timeline & milestones, 5) immediate action items.

Please reply with the best slot and who should attend from your side — we recommend product, security, and your integration lead. I’ve looped Marissa (CS lead) to handle staffing and Camila (ops) for access/runbook items.

Attachments: redwood_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF)
Drive prework: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c_kickoff-prework

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0176

From: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@healthsync.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nikhil Rao <nra@healthsync.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Project initiation: book kickoff call, attendee roster, and run of show

Diego —

Thanks, that looks good. Wed 1 Sep, 14:00–15:00 PT works best for our team. Attendees from HealthSync: Claire (PM), Nikhil (CTO), Priya Desai (integration lead) — I’ll add calendar invites once you confirm the link.

Quick notes:
- We’ll need a short pre-kickoff doc that lists SSO requirements and current data export formats; I’ve shared a small sample in reply.
- Can your team confirm whether we should expect an SFTP exchange or API-based ingestion for the first phase?

Best,
Claire
Head of Product | HealthSync

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Project initiation: book kickoff call, attendee roster, and run of show

Diego / Camila —

Great — locking Wed 1 Sep 14:00 PT. Ben, can you cover the integration technical owners and confirm who from product implementation should be on the call? I’ll prepare the attendee roster and a one-page success checklist to share during the kickoff.

Action items for internal coordination:
- Ben: confirm tech lead and whether SFTP or API is the expected first path.
- Camila: prepare access checklist and SSO slide (5 min).
- Diego: confirm Zoom link and send calendar invite to HealthSync.

I’ll attach an attendee roster template; fill your columns and return by end of day tomorrow.

Attachments: attendee_roster_sheet.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 15:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Project initiation: book kickoff call, attendee roster, and run of show

Marissa —

Priya (HealthSync) indicated yesterday in the discovery that they prefer API-based ingestion for low-latency flows; SFTP is feasible for bulk exports but will add manual steps. I recommend we have both options on the table at kickoff and identify an MVP ingestion path.

I’ll join kickoff as technical owner; propose we also invite one engineer from Runtime (to cover tokenization/limits) and one from Security (for data retention/QoS).

I’ve added notes to the roster and highlighted needed action items in column C.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Rao <nra@healthsync.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: HealthSync kickoff — Wed 1 Sep 14:00–15:00 PT 

Claire —

Confirmed for Wed 1 Sep, 14:00–15:00 PT. Zoom link and calendar invite are below. We’ll keep the agenda tight (attached) and leave 15 minutes for action items and next steps.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=kickoff
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?action=TEMPLATE&eid=healthsync_kickoff_1sep
Drive prework & shared notes: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c_kickoff-prework

Attendees (Redwood): Diego Fernandez (AE), Marissa Cole (CSM), Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer), Camila Reyes (Onboarding Ops), Runtime engineer (TBD), Security SME (TBD)
Attendees (HealthSync): Claire Zhou (PM), Nikhil Rao (CTO), Priya Desai (Integration Lead)

Attachments: redwood_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf, attendee_roster_sheet.xlsx

If there are platform access prerequisites (IP allowlist, test tenant), Camila will share the onboarding checklist tomorrow morning. Look forward to it.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
